triples.tail_surface: Check length from motor shaft end to motor flange being within +/-0.5 mm of the nominal length
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查电机轴端至电机法兰长度在标称长度±0.5mm内
triples.evidence_text: Check length from motor shaft end to motor flange being within +/-0.5 mm of the nominal length (like 60, 80, 110, 140 and 170 mm).

triples.tail_surface: fit a pointed screw glued into the motor shaft end to adjust the pump shaft to correct mounting position
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在电机轴端胶接尖头螺钉以调整泵轴至正确安装位置
triples.evidence_text: If the motor shaft is too short then fit a pointed screw glued into the motor shaft end to adjust the pump shaft to correct mounting position – inorder to ensure correct build in length for the ELK shaft seal.

triples.tail_canonical_zh: 机加工或铣削至标称长度
triples.evidence_text: If the motor shaft is too long then it has to be machined / milled to nominal length.

triples.tail_surface: checked if the shaft sealing have the correct length when mounted on the pump shaft
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查轴封安装在泵轴上时长度是否正确
triples.evidence_text: It has to be checked if the shaft sealing have the correct length when mounted on the pump shaft as shown below.

triples.tail_surface: make sure that the electric motor is with locked bearing in the drive end
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 确认电动机驱动端轴承已锁定
triples.evidence_text: Also make sure that the electric motor is with locked bearing in the drive end – i.e. there must not be forced axial stroke of the electric motor.
